biography: Ivan Jacoma, a name synonymous with audacious overtakes and flamboyant celebrations, hails from the tranquil Swiss Alps, a stark contrast to the roaring engines he now commands. His entry into motorsport was almost accidental. During a ski trip as a teenager, he stumbled upon a local hillclimb event. Captivated by the raw power and daring maneuvers, Ivan traded his skis for a steering wheel, much to the initial dismay of his family. He started in karting, quickly showcasing a natural talent for reading the track and an aggressive, some might say reckless, overtaking style. A defining moment came during the Swiss Karting Championship in 2012. Trailing in third place on the final lap, Ivan executed a daring double overtake, squeezing past both rivals on the inside of a hairpin, securing the championship. Now, at 30, racing for the Camaro team, Ivan finds himself at the peak of his powers, a constant threat for podium finishes and a guaranteed crowd-pleaser.
drivingStyle: Ivan's driving style is characterized by a high-risk, high-reward approach. He's known for his late braking and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the limits of grip to gain an advantage. Tire management isn't exactly his forte, preferring to extract maximum performance in short bursts rather than conserving for the long haul. Under pressure, Ivan tends to thrive, relishing the challenge and often producing his best results when the stakes are highest. His aggressive style sometimes leads to collisions, but also to spectacular overtakes.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision during the 2019 Monza Grand Prix. Alvarez blamed Ivan for costing him the race.
Dubois and Jacoma have often butted heads on and off track, their differing ideologies on racing causing tension.
Tanaka considers Jacoma's style reckless and unsportsmanlike, leading to several on-track altercations and heated exchanges in the media.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, gifted by his grandmother, for every race.
Listens to a specific opera aria precisely 30 minutes before each race start to calm his nerves, despite not being a fan of opera otherwise.
Insists on personally polishing his steering wheel before every session, believing it improves his grip and connection with the car.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe. It's about pushing the limits, taking risks, and leaving everything on the track. If you're not on the edge, you're taking up space."
careerHighlight: Winning the prestigious Monaco Grand Prix in 2022. Starting from fifth on the grid, Ivan navigated a chaotic race with masterful skill, overtaking two cars in the final lap to secure a memorable victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2021. While leading with a comfortable margin, a momentary lapse in concentration resulted in a spin and heavy impact, costing his team a certain victory.
